stories.title: President Zardari, PML-Q chief Shujaat discuss country's political situation
stories.brief: President Asif Ali Zardari on Friday discussed the country’s political situation in a meeting with former prime minister and Pakistan Muslim League-Quaid (PML-Q) chief Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain. Earlier this week, Naqvi also held a meeting with Shujaat, where the debate over the creation of new provinces and devolution of powers was discussed.

stories.title: President Zardari, Shujaat discuss national affairs, political situation
stories.brief: President Asif Ali Zardari on Friday met former prime minister and PML-Q chief Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain, where the two leaders discussed national affairs and the prevailing political situation, according to a statement issued by the President's House.

stories.title: No threat to government as PM Shehbaz-CDF Munir partnership continues: Talal Chaudhry
stories.brief: Speaking on a private television programme, Naya Pakistan, Chaudhry said the government believed in political consultations and that all major decisions were taken after bringing coalition partners on board. Referring to Fazl's recent remarks, Chaudhry said the political resentment and anger in the JUI-F chief's statements were evident in his interviews and public appearances.

stories.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
stories.brief: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

stories.title: Will new energy fixes cost more in January?
stories.brief: Energy bills will soar by 26% for millions of households in January after a surge in gas prices sparked by the Iran war.

stories.title: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
stories.brief: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

stories.title: FIR over Karachi building collapse omits government officials despite SBCA action
stories.brief: A six-storey under-construction building in Karachi collapsed on Wednesday, killing eight people and injuring 14 others. The absence of any government official among the nominated accused raises questions about the scope of the investigation, particularly the role of regulatory authorities responsible for overseeing construction and enforcing building regulations.

stories.title: Bilawal says South Punjab has constitutional right to separate province, opposes dividing Punjab into four
stories.brief: Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Friday voiced support for the creation of a separate South Punjab province, saying it was the "wish of the people", but opposed dividing Punjab into four provinces.

stories.title: What is Modi's automated takedown law, which has embroiled Meta in a political storm?
stories.brief: Meta's online disclosures show it restricted access to 5.44 million items of content in India in the first half of 2026, about 130 times ​the 41,357 restricted in the previous six months.

stories.brief: Cities including Lagos and Alexandria are sinking faster than previously thought, a new study shows.

stories.brief: Hundreds of thousands of people were without power after severe weather hit both coasts of the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday.

stories.brief: Macy's postpones its 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York because of severe weather.

stories.brief: Some new balloons are set to fly in the weather-delayed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Floating nature islands installed in parks as Glasgow Games legacy
stories.brief: The islands, being planted in five Glasgow parks, are designed to encourage wildlife and help clean the water.
